heading: Periodic in person verification
lead: A sex offender shall appear in person, allow the jurisdiction to take a current photograph, and verify the information in each registry in which that offender is required to be registered not less frequently than—

tree.text: each year, if the offender is a tier I sex offender;
every 6 months, if the offender is a tier II sex offender; and
every 3 months, if the offender is a tier III sex offender.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 16916 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
